title: The Rooke Papers: a descriptive list (Collection List No. 48)

used: On 11 April 1912 Henry Rooke, solicitor, eldest son of Archdeacon Henry Rooke (rector of Wicklow 1873–1906), married Cecilia Eliza Margaret Bellingham Somerville, daughter of Bellingham Arthur Somerville of Clermont; she signed herself Cecil B. Rooke (1880–1973), extracted wills at the Public Record Office in 1912 and registered the Somerville and Rooke pedigrees at the Genealogical Office in February 1955 (G.O. MS 182A, Somerville pp. 119–130); Henry Rooke died in 1942; four children, including Col. H. T. B. B. (Tommy) Rooke and Dorothy Rooke. Clermont was bought by B. A. Somerville in the mid-1890s from Col. Charles George Tottenham of Ballycurry. B. A. Somerville copied many Somerville wills in the Public Record Office in the late 19th century (Ms. 33,586); "The Somerville Papers are now in the possession of Mr. William Somerville" (1998). Letters from Reg Somerville at Clermont (1946) and from Vere (1955).
